info.title: Rushd API
info.description: Versioned JSON API for Rushd's native clients. Bearer tokens only (no cookies). Every error is `{ "error": { "code", "message" } }`. See docs/API.md.

servers.description: Relative to the Rushd deployment, e.g. http://localhost:3000/api/v1

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description: Same password check, rate limits (10 attempts per IP+email and 30 per IP per 15 minutes) and enumeration-safe error as the web login.
Returns a new pair and revokes the presented refresh token. Presenting a token that was already rotated or revoked revokes every token from that sign-in (refresh_token_reused).

post.summary: Sign out this device, or everywhere
post.description: `{ refreshToken }` ends that sign-in (no access token needed). `{ everywhere: true }` needs a bearer token and signs the student out of every device and every web session. With neither, ends the sign-in the bearer token belongs to.

get.description: Next up with reasons, today's study blocks, coming up with due status, this week's workload, and study time per course. Same logic as the web dashboard.
Open work ranked by Pulse then due date (like the web list); work Canvas stopped listing after it; completed newest first.

patch.summary: Mark done / not done, or edit
patch.description: `{ status }` alone marks it complete or not. Other fields are merged into the current values; Canvas keeps ownership of an imported assignment's title, due date and course.

404.description: Assignment or course not found (or not yours)

get.summary: One course with its open work

post.description: Exactly one of assignmentId or examId. Only one session can be in progress.

404.description: Assignment or exam not found (or not yours, or already completed)

409.description: Another session is already in progress

post.description: The student confirms the minutes; the app's timer is only a suggestion.

Unauthorized.description: unauthorized (missing, forged, or revoked token) or token_expired (refresh and retry)

accessToken.description: HS256 JWT, valid 15 minutes. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

refreshToken.description: 43-character opaque token. Store in the device keychain; it rotates on every refresh.

dueLabel.description: Formatted in the student's time zone, e.g. "Tomorrow, 11:59 PM"

removedUpstream.description: Canvas no longer lists it; kept but left out of the plan.

pulse.description: 0-100: how strongly it needs the student now. Null for finished work.

code.description: As the student entered it; never invented.

reasons.description: Plain-language reasons from the planner's real score, at most 3.
